title: Archduke Franz Ferdinand is assassinated in Sarajevo
summary: Gavrilo Princip, a Bosnian Serb nationalist, shot dead the heir to the Austro-Hungarian throne Franz Ferdinand and his wife Sophie in Sarajevo.
reason: Young Bosnia and the Black Hand sought to end Austro-Hungarian rule over South Slavs.
significance: The killing triggered the July Crisis that led to World War I.
place: Latin Bridge, Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina
